title: Saturating counts through a live Guava multiset sum
summary: Two independently populated backing multisets expose their capped mathematical sum through lookup, size and entry iteration.

change.description: Two independently populated backing multisets expose their capped mathematical sum through lookup, size and entry iteration.

notes: The frozen independent observation table has 49 rows. Each property identifies its own input range. The subject JDK is Temurin 21.0.13.

Two counts of 2³⁰ yielded size 2³¹−1, lookup −2³¹ and an exception from the first entry on the parent. All three observers yield 2³¹−1 on the fix. An absent key stays at zero and mutating a backing count updates both observers of the same live view from six to seven.
The existing live-view and iterator support already covered the backing objects, saturated addition, empty iteration and exhaustion.
